questions.title: Life expectancy at birth in the world
questions.hint: Life expectancy reflects deaths at every age, so a change among the young moves it most.
questions.explanation: It rose to 73.2 years in 2023, from 53.7 years in 1963.

source.attribution: UN Population Division, World Population Prospects

questions.title: Share of adults with obesity in the United States
questions.unitLabel: % of adults 20+, measured, by survey starting year
questions.hint: Food environments and body weights tend to change slowly, across generations.
questions.explanation: It rose to 42% in 2017, from 31% in 1999.

source.attribution: US CDC, National Center for Health Statistics

questions.title: Share of children who die before age five in Nigeria
questions.hint: Vaccines, clean water, and treatment for diarrheal disease all reach children first.
questions.explanation: It fell to 11.4% in 2020, from 34.1% in 1950.

source.attribution: UN Population Division, World Population Prospects

questions.title: Annual population growth rate in Japan
questions.hint: Growth depends on births minus deaths, plus migration. It can be negative.
questions.explanation: It fell to -0.4% in 2020, from 1.7% in 1950.

source.attribution: UN Population Division, World Population Prospects

questions.title: Average number of children per woman in France
questions.hint: Fertility tends to respond to education, urban living, contraception, and the cost of raising children.
questions.explanation: It fell to 1.8 in 2020, from 2.7 in 1960.

source.attribution: UN Population Division, World Population Prospects
